briefs.episode_title: Microsoft Says 86% Treat AI Output as a Starting Point. Your Resume Just Stopped Working.
briefs.channel: AI News & Strategy Daily | Nate B Jones
briefs.one_line_summary: Traditional metrics of productivity are losing value as AI increasingly blurs the line between genuine and superficial accomplishment.
core_claims: 86% of people treat AI output as a starting point.
58% of AI users produce work they could not have a year ago; among advanced users, this rises to 80%.
briefs.positioning_implication: Prioritize evaluation methods focusing on live reasoning and decision-making processes over polished outputs.  Emphasis shift to showing how you learn and update thinking in response to challenges.

briefs.episode_title: He Called Silver’s 35% Pullback – Now He Says This Happens Next | Mike Lee
briefs.one_line_summary: AI infrastructure spending is widely misunderstood, and despite global economic concerns, certain equities present opportunities.
core_claims: The amount of data for large language models is growing at a hockey stick exponential growth rate.
A trillion dollars of AI infrastructure spend is estimated next year, and is expected to grow to three trillion annually in 2030.
Analysts were expecting 13% year-over-year growth, but results have come in at 28%.
Silver is expected to grind up to $100 in the next year.
The cost of capital for Coreweave has dropped from mid-teens to mid-single digits over the last year.
briefs.positioning_implication: Favor companies poised to benefit from AI infrastructure and data demands; allocate strategically to precious metals as hedges against global economic uncertainty. Adapt investment strategies to navigate potential geopolitical risks.
